metadata.name: manual_clip_friendly_5_prompts_per_class_v3
metadata.style: CLIP-friendly surveillance caption prompts with stronger class separation.
metadata.source: Hybrid rewrite from manual_caption_10x v1 and v2 using manual prompt diagnostics.
design_notes: This version reduces each class from 10 prompts to 5 prompts.
Prompts were selected or rewritten using prompt-level AP, margin, text confusion, and class similarity diagnostics.
Explosion and Arson are separated by instant blast cues versus human ignition and gradual flame growth.
Burglary, Robbery, Stealing, and Shoplifting are separated by forced entry, victim coercion, unattended property, and retail concealment.
Shooting, Assault, Fighting, and Arrest are separated by firearm discharge, one-sided attack, mutual combat, and police custody cues.
Prompts avoid negation-heavy wording because CLIP may not reliably encode negative constraints.

Abuse: a vulnerable victim enduring repeated close range mistreatment
a stronger aggressor controlling a weaker victim indoors
a helpless person recoiling from sustained physical abuse
a defenseless victim shielding from repeated aggressive contact
an aggressor dragging or overpowering a vulnerable person
Arrest: uniformed police placing handcuffs on a detained suspect
officers escorting a handcuffed person toward a patrol car
a handcuffed suspect standing between multiple police officers
law enforcement securing a suspect during formal custody
a detained person kneeling while officers apply restraints
Arson: a person lighting flammable material before flames spread
a person pouring accelerant before visible fire grows
a lighter touching a surface before ignition begins
small flames expanding after deliberate human ignition
a person retreating as planted fire starts spreading
Assault: a single attacker lunging with a direct strike
a one-sided attack with punches and defensive movement
an aggressor kicking a fallen victim on pavement
a victim stumbling backward after a sudden hit
an attacker chasing one target while striking repeatedly
Burglary: an intruder forcing entry through a locked doorway
a person prying a lock before entering property
a masked intruder breaking into a closed building
a person climbing through a window into private space
an intruder entering rooms after damaging an entry point
Explosion: an instant detonation expanding from a blast center
a shockwave pushing fragments outward within seconds
a structure bursting apart from explosive force
a concentrated blast throwing debris radially outward
a sudden pressure wave following a visible detonation
Fighting: two groups mutually exchanging punches in a brawl
multiple participants striking each other during mutual combat
opponents separating and reengaging in group fighting
several combatants grappling and swinging simultaneously
two sides clashing back and forth in public
Normal: pedestrians walking calmly along an ordinary street
people waiting and talking in a public area
vehicles moving steadily through regular traffic
customers standing calmly near store counters
people entering and exiting buildings at normal pace
RoadAccidents: a vehicle collision causing roadway impact and disruption
a car striking a pedestrian or cyclist on road
a motorbike sliding across a lane after collision
vehicles swerving before colliding in traffic
a crashed vehicle blocking lanes after impact
Robbery: a threatening person forcing a victim to surrender valuables
a victim handing belongings under close range intimidation
an attacker cornering a victim and seizing items
a person brandishing a weapon to demand property
a robber confronting a victim before taking belongings
Shooting: an armed person aiming and firing a firearm
a visible muzzle flash from a discharged gun
a shooter raising a gun before firing
a person firing a handgun in surveillance footage
an armed shooter discharging a weapon toward people
Shoplifting: a shopper concealing merchandise inside clothing or bag
a person hiding a retail item while browsing shelves
store goods disappearing beneath a jacket while shopping
a shopper slipping merchandise into a bag in aisle
a customer exiting retail space with concealed merchandise
Stealing: a person taking unattended property and leaving quickly
a thief grabbing a bicycle, bag, phone, or object
a suspect carrying property while the owner is distracted
a person pocketing an unattended item and changing direction
a thief quietly removing property from public space
Vandalism: a person smashing a window or door with force
a suspect spraying graffiti directly onto public property
a person breaking glass with repeated tool impacts
someone striking fixtures until visible damage appears
a person deliberately damaging property with tools or kicks
